name: c-to-rust-superpowers
description: Orchestrate a C-to-Rust port across the superpowers ladder: new ports, remediating an existing port to standard, or resyncing after upstream C changes. Bundles the translation method (faithful then prove then idiomatic) and a fresh-context faithful-port review gate that re-derives the reference independently. Use when planning, porting, sweeping, resyncing, or reviewing a C-to-Rust port.
